Commentary.Commentary: The ball is turning and the score looks a good one on this deck. But given the way the hosts batted in the previous ODI, it's difficult to pick the favourite at this stage. The equation is slightly in favour of the visitors here. Will the series be leveled today or will the Windies take an unassailable lead? Join us in a bit for the chase...

Azam got to his ton while Wasim scored a breezy 43 and together the duo stitched a vital 99-run stand off 68 balls to provide the impetus to their side. West Indies bowled well but lost the plot in the final few overs. The spin duo of Bishoo and Nurse did the job of drying up the runs while pacer Gabriel was impressive too. Jospeh was a bit expensive but will be happy to have scalped a wicket to his name.

A terrific finish from Pakistan as they plundered 62 runs from the last 5 overs to rack up a brilliant total on the board. After being put into bat, their openers didn't last long. But Babar Azam looked confident from the moment he stepped in and played with sheer authority. He kept losing partners at the other end and hence took it all on himself. Imad Wasim though hung around and should be praised here for rotating the strike and then dispatching once he got his eyes in.

SIX! What a shot to end the innings! Fuller in length on off and middle, Babar Azam stays put and lofts it cleanly over the head of the bowler for a maximum. What an over for Pakistan, 19 runs from it. PAKISTAN FINISH ON 282/5!
Yorker around off, Wasim heaves it towards square leg for a single. Good comeback by the bowler after the two hits on the first two balls.
Too full on middle, Azam clips it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. They think of the second but the throw is a good one from Nurse in the deep.
Full outside off, hit hard to extra cover for a single.

FOUR! In the gap! Too full outside off, Wasim squeezes it through backward point for a boundary. The fielder inside the ring was signalling to someone but there was no one in the deep. 10 from 2 already!
SIX! Take that, Carter! Length ball outside off, Wasim gets under it and launches it over the long on fence for a maximum. West Indies could really lose the plot in this over!
Jonathan Carter to bowl the final over of the innings!
FOUR! Big over! Low full toss on middle and leg, Azam clips it through square leg for a boundary. Top over this for the visitors. 13 from it.
Too full outside off, Azam looks to flay it away but misses.
SIX! The hits are coming at last! Full outside off, Azam gets under it and launches it over long off for a maximum.

Too full outside off, Azam goes for the drive but gets an outside edge towards third man. Evin Lewis gets across from the deep and stops it. He almost lets it through. Thankfully not and a couple taken.
Another full toss outside off, Azam swings at it and misses.
Angles it on the stumps, Wasim nudges it towards short fine leg for a single.
Full toss outside off, Azam backs away to hit that one but fails to put bat to ball.
SIX! Needed to hit that before? Joseph bowls it on the stumps again, Babar Azam gets under it and launches it over long on for a biggie. 250 up for Pakistan!
Mistimes his heave towards extra cover for a single.
SIX! Into the stands! Fuller in length on the stumps, Wasim gets under it and lofts it cleanly over the long on fence for a maximum.
Too full outside off, Wasim looks to sweep but it misses.
5th ODI ton for Babar Azam!

Well played, Babar! Low full toss outside off, Babar Azam pushes it towards point for a quick single. He gets to his century, he is elated and why not. He has turned up on the big stage to bring his century. He will want to attack from hereon.
Fuller outside off, slower in pace, Azam drives it through mid off for a single. Retains the strike, he is on 99 now!
Shorter outside off, Wasim looks to go over mid-wicket but ends dragging it to long on for a single.
Too full outside off, squirted down to third man for a single. He moves onto 98!
Too full outside off, Azam looks to dig it out but fails to do so.
50-run stand between Wasim and Azam!
Good length outside off, Azam nudges it through backward square leg for a couple of runs.
Wasim comes down the wicket and lofts it down to long on for a single.
Jason Holder brought back on for a spell.
Bowls it around off, Wasim looks to paddle it but is hit on his pads. There is an appeal for an lbw but nothing from the umpire. That looked to have pitched outside leg. A leg bye taken.
FOUR! Slapped! Joseph bowls it wide outside off, Wasim manages to slap it just wide of the diving extra cover fielder for a boundary.
Fuller in length on off, nudged towards square leg for a single.
WIDE! Watches the batsman make room and looks to follow him. Ends up spraying it down the leg side for a wide.
Fuller around off, Wasim heaves it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Banged in short outside off, Babar cuts it towards point for a quick single. That was there to be hit but the batsman missed out.
Low full toss on off, bunted down to long on for a single.
Fuller in length on the stumps, Wasim gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball rolls towards the off side and they take a single. Shannon Gabriel ends his spell with figures of 10-1-50-2!
Shorter outside off, cut through covers for a single.
Slower and fuller on off, Wasim pushes it towards covers for a single.
Shorter in length outside off, Wasim looks to flay it over covers but ends up slicing it down to deep third man for a couple of runs.
Fuller outside off, Wasim comes down and slices it over covers for a couple of runs.
Good length on off, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller in length, Wasim looks to go over mid on but ends up hitting it on the bounce to the fielder inside the ring.
Worked through wide mid on for a single.
WIDE! Tries the slower one but slants it down the leg side. A wide is signaled.
Fuller outside off, hit down to long off for a single.
Full outside off, dabbed towards short third man for a single.
FOUR! Asking to be hit, and hit! Jospeh bowls it on a good length around off, Babar Azam was waiting for it and pummels it over mid-wicket for a boundary. Really poor bowling, there. Moves to 89!
Free Hit time!
FOUR! Smacked! Shorter in length outside off, Babar Azam makes the most of it and pulls it through square leg for a boundary. It is a huge no ball for overstepping and a Free Hit is to follow!
Fuller outside off, Wasim comes down swinging at it but mistimes it to long off for a single.
Alzarri Joseph brought back on for a bowl.
Lands it on a length at off, Wasim pushes it towards covers for a quick single.
Good length around off, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller outside off, pushed towards extra cover from his crease.
Lands it around leg, worked through short fine leg for a single.
Good length outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single.
Fuller outside off, Azam mistimes his clip towards mid-wicket.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point. Nurse finishes with figures of - 10-0-42-1!
Walks across and nudges it through the leg side for one more.
Darted around middle, worked through mid-wicket for one.
Drops it short around off, Azam punches it off the back foot through covers for a single.
Floated outside off, pushed towards the off side for a single.
Tossed up around off, driven towards long off for a single.
Length delivery, slanting away, Wasim feels for it and gets beaten.
Fuller on off, driven towards mid off.
There is a message from the Pakistan captain for the batsmen out there.

NOT OUT! Drama out there! Gabriel keeps it full on off, Imad Wasim looks to defend but seems to have missed it. There is some noise as the ball went past the bat. The Windies keep appealing and the umpire rules it out LBW. Imad Wasim walks down and has a word with his partner before taking the review. The TV umpire looks at it from various angles and takes a lot of time. The replays show the noise was of the ball hitting the off stump and much to Wasim's delight the bails didn't come off. Umpire Ian Gould thought it hit the pad and hence gave it out. Wasim survives and it's a good use of the review.
What happened there? Wasim has been given out lbw but he has asked for a review. That looks close as it also hit the stumps but the bails did not come off. Will the southpaw get away with this one?
Shortish outside off, Imad off the back foot cuts it towards the point fielder.
Back of a length outside off, dabbed towards point.
Leg bye! Good length delivery on middle, Azam stays back to clip but the ball goes off the pads towards the leg side. A leg bye taken.
The umpire signals the start of Powerplay 3. Five fielders are now allowed outside the circle.

Stumping chance goes down abegging! Lovely piece of bowling from Nurse! Tosses it up outside off, Azam comes dancing down the track to hit it through the line. The ball turns in with good amount of bounce sneaks through the batsman. Hope behind the stumps fails to collect it as the ball goes off his gloves. They take a bye.
Flatter one around off, straightens a bit as Azam looks to defend. Is beaten all ends up.
Around middle and leg, flicked towards square leg.
Floats it up outside off, Azam pushes it with soft hands towards covers for a single.
Full around off, driven down to long on got another single.
Comes from around the wicket and tosses it up around off, it's a low full toss, Wasim drives it down to long off for a single.
Ashley Nurse returns for a bowl.
Shortish delivery outside off, chops it away towards covers for a single. A successful over from Gabriel!
Angles away a length ball, Wasim shoulders his arms.
Imad Wasim is the new man in.

OUT! Soft dismissal! Gabriel hurls in a full length delivery, angling in, Sarfraz looks to clip it but seems to be early into the stroke and that does him in. The ball pops off the leading edge and it's the simplest of the catches to Chadwick Walton at mid on. West Indies have removed half the Pakistan side now.
Leg bye! Good length ball on middle, Azam looks to flick but the ball goes off the pads towards the leg side. A leg bye taken.
On a length and outside off, defended down the wicket.
Once again it's on the pads, Babar gets across and flicks it through square leg. Bishoo in the deep comes to his right to make an excellent stop. A couple added to the total.
Wide! Slants it down the leg side, Babar moves inside the line and lets it be.
Shannon Gabriel is back into the attack!
Flatter on the stumps, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Lands it on middle and leg, Ahmed clips it towards square leg for a single. 50-run stand up as well.
Fuller outside off, nudged towards short fine leg for a single.
Sweeps this one through backward square leg for a single.
Goes round the wicket, fires it around off, Sarfraz defends it watchfully.
FOUR! Top, top shot! Sarfraz comes down the wicket, gets to the pitch of the ball and clobbers it through mid-wicket for a boundary. He picked the ball even before it was delivered.
Length ball outside off, dabbed towards short third man for a single.
Babar guides this one off the outer half down to third man for a single.
Fuller outside off, Sarfraz sweeps it towards short fine leg for a quick single.
This one is driven to mid off and they take a single having spotted that it was Gabriel stationed there.
Fuller outside off, Babar Azam cuts it but finds the fielder at point.
Fuller on off, bunted back to the bowler who dives to his left in his followthrough to stop it.
Jonathan Carter called on for a bowl.
Loopy ball around off, Azam flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Leg bye! Floats it up around off, Ahmed looks flick but misses as the ball goes off the pads towards the off side. A leg bye taken.
Darts it around middle, nudged through mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball around off, Azam drives it towards mid off and sets off. An unnecessary throw at the bowler's end allows them to take one more.
Tossed up outside off, Azam drives it hard but finds the man at covers.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Length ball, angling in, clipped behind square on the leg side for a single.
Fuller in length and angling in, Sarfraz comes down a step and eases it through mid on for a single.
Fuller and it's on the driving length, Ahmed goes for it but finds the cover fielder.
Shortish outside off, dabbed straight to gully.
Angling on middle and leg, tucked towards the leg side for a single.
Short and turning in, cut towards sweeper cover off the back foot for a single.
Wide! Fires it down the leg side, Azam looks to flick but fails to do so.
Tossed up delivery around off, Azam defends it down.
Sarfraz Ahmed slinks down the track and drags it down to long on for a single.
Very full on middle, jammed out towards short mid-wicket.
Short and around off, Azam goes back and punches it through covers for a single.
Allows the ball to come back and then dabs it with soft hands towards point for a single.
Fuller on off, driven through covers for a single.
Comes down the wicket and flicks it in front of square on the leg side for a couple.

FOUR! And another edge! Holder can't believe his luck here! On a length and outside off, Sarfraz once again keeps his bat face open and again an outside edge is induced. This time it too wide for the keeper to take it. Yet another streaky boundary for the Pakistan skipper.

FOUR! Edged and dropped by the keeper! It was a tough chance though but Hope was having a great time behind the stumps till now. On a length and angling across, Ahmed looks to guide it down to third man but the ball takes the outside part of the willow and goes towards the right of the keeper who dives but the ball goes off the gloves for a boundary.
Landed outside off, Azam dabs it down to third man for a single.
Fuller in length and angling in, the batsman gets across and defends it towards the leg side.
Jason Holder comes back into the attack!
Drinks.
Loopy delivery around off, turning in as Sarfraz goes back to cut. Gets an inside edge on the pads and the ball dies down.
Goes back, opens the face of the bat and dabs it wide of the point fielder for a single.
Fires it full and around the pads, Azam looks to flick but gets it off the pads down to fine leg. Two leg byes taken.
Tossed up outside off, pushed towards covers for nothing.
Flatter through the air, Azam goes back and defends it towards the leg side.
Tossed up around middle, Ahmed flicks it a bit uppishly through wide mid on for a single.
Very full around middle, wristed down to long on for a single.
Tossed up around off, driven through covers for a single.
Comes down the track to this loopy ball and clips it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Short and outside off, cut off the back foot towards point.
Short on middle, Ahmed drags the pull to long on for a single.
Full around middle, nudged towards square leg for a single.
Sarfraz turns this one towards mid-wicket off his crease.
Floats it outside off, pushed towards cover-point. Hope goes to his right and stops the ball prevents the single.
Flatter outside off, punched to long on for a single.
Shorter outside off, punched towards the off side by Azam.
Flatter on middle and leg, nudged towards short fine leg.
WIDE! Fires this one down the leg side, Babar fails to sweep it. A wide is signaled.
Flatter outside off, punched towards mid on. The bowler goes to his right and stops the ball.
Drops it half way down the track, Sarfraz goes back and pulls it towards mid-wicket.
Skipper Sarfraz Ahmed is the new man in.

OUT! Big wicket, that! Bishoo floats it outside off, Malik lunges forward to drive but gets an outside edge which is superbly taken by the keeper. Hope instinctively looks to take the bails off but then realizes that he has actually caught an edge and then appeals. The umpire rules it out and the experienced Pakistan batsman has to walk back to the hut.
Malik comes forward and pushes it back down the wicket.
Flatter on off and middle, Babar goes back to pull but gets it off the inner half down to long on for a single.
Shorter again around off, hit wide of the cover fielder for a single.
Shorter outside off, Malik goes back and punches it towards covers.
Malik lunges forward and defends it watchfully for a single.
Punches one towards covers for a single.
Flatter on the stumps, Malik clips it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Malik comes down to hit one but gets an inside edge towards short fine leg.
Nudges it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller outside off, Azam gets across and looks to work it through but does not connect with his clip cleanly. A mild appeal turned down.
Floats it outside off, driven towards extra cover by Malik.
Shorter outside off, Malik shapes to cut but is beaten by the turn on that one.
Flatter outside off, Malik waits for ti and guides it down to third man for a couple of runs.
Malik gets in line and defends this one.
7th ODI fifty for Babar Azam!
Drives this one through covers for a single.
Fuller outside off, driven through covers for a couple of runs. There was a chance at the striker's end but the throw is a wide one and that allows the batsman to get into his crease.
Flatter down the leg side, left alone expecting a wide but it is not given.
Flatter on middle, clipped through mid-wicket for a brace.
Flatter on off, Malik goes back and works it through square leg for a couple of runs to get off the mark.
Shorter outside off, Malik camps back and punches it to short extra cover.
Fuller on the stumps, worked towards the leg side.
Flatter on the pads, worked towards square leg.
Shoaib Malik is the new man in, replacing Hafeez!

Commentary.Detail: W+wd st shai hope b ashley nurse
Commentary.Commentary: OUT! Nurse strikes! Fires it down the leg side expecting the charge from the batsman. Hafeez does comes down the wicket to clip it through but is beaten all ends up. Hope behind the wickets has an eternity to take the bails off and he does so cleanly and in time. Hafeez has to walk back to the pavilion. His misery comes to an end. It is signaled a wide too but the bowler won't be complaining since he has got a big wicket.
Pushes it towards mid on for a single.
Hafeez once again finds the fielder at extra cover.
Drops it short outside off, punched through covers for a run.
Comes down and drives it through mid off for a single.
Spots the batsman coming down and bowls a full toss wide outside off, Hafeez comes down and mistimes it back to the bowler who dives to his left and stops the ball.
Too full around off, Hafeez pushes it towards short extra cover.
Comes down the track and eases it down to long on for a single.
Loops it outside off, guided towards short third man by Hafeez.
Floats it outside off, Hafeez brings out the sweep shot but finds the fielder at square leg.
This time Babar nudges it towards square leg for a single.
Azam gets across and works it with the spin towards mid-wicket.
Lands it outside off, Babar Azam looks to get across and work it through but is rapped on the pads. Stifled appeal turned down.
Ashley Nurse,  the star from the last match comes on to bowl. Also, Shannon Gabriel is seen walking off the field...

Beaten! Slants it outside off on a length, Hafeez shapes to defend but is once again beaten by the inward movement. The keeper gathers the ball in time. Replays show it kept low too and did not miss the off stump by much. Gabriel has a wry smile on his face. Hafeez continues to fight his battle.

On a good length, angling on the pads, Babar nudges it off his pads next to the wicket and scampers through for a single. Gabriel is holding his hamstring once again, the home side will want him to be fit enough to bowl all his overs.
Angles it on a length, worked towards mid-wicket.
Slants it outside off, Hafeez taps it towards the off side for a single.
FOUR! Poor ball and punished! Slips out a full toss on the pads, Hafeez clips it through square leg for a boundary.
Lands it outside off, Hafeez pushes it towards covers and looks for a single but is sent back.
Lands it around off, Babar pushes it back to the bowler. Good comeback by Bishoo after the six on the first ball.
Fuller outside off, Azam mistimes his drive to short extra cover.
Shorter outside off, cut through point for a single.
Fuller on middle, played back to the bowler by Hafeez.
Too full outside off, pushed towards extra cover.

SIX! What an effort though, Jason Mohammed! Full toss outside off, Hafeez comes down the wicket and looks to go over long off. He looks to have clear the fence but Jason Mohammed comes to his right, flies to take the catch but cannot hold onto the chance. Would have been a stunner had he taken it, really.
50-run stand up between Hafeez and Azam.
Slants it on a good length, Hafeez dabs it down to third man for a single.
Fuller outside off, Hafeez comes forward to defend. He taps it towards the off side and looks for a quick single but is sent back.
Good length outside off, glided down to third man for a run.
Fuller outside off, Azam drives it on the up through covers for a single.
Beaten! Slants it outside off, on a good length, Azam looks to chop it down but the ball comes in late and beats the batsman on the inside edge.
Starts off with a length ball outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single.
Shannon Gabriel returns for a bowl.
MH takes a stride forward and drives it through covers for a single.
Works it wide of long on for one.

Lewis what a stop that is! A long hop from Bishoo and Azam goes back to pull it over mid-wicket. The West Indian opener in the deep comes sprinting to his right and makes a diving stop to save a certain boundary. Two runs taken.
The batsman drives this through the covers.
Full on the stumps, driven to long on for a single.
Tossed up around off, Hafeez comes down the track and drives it towards covers where Walton dives and stops it.
Short on middle and leg, tucked behind square on the leg side for a couple.
FOUR! Good shot! Fuller length delivery on off, Azam lunges forward and drives it past Holder at mid off who gives it a chase. The West Indian skipper puts in a dive to stop it but fails to do so.
Short and angling on the pads, Hafeez comes down the track to pull it away but the ball goes off the pads and flies towards backward point. They collect a leg bye.
Fuller in length and around off, Azam drives it towards mid on and scampers through for a single.
Fuller on off, Azam pushes it towards the man at mid off.
Shortish and angling in, Babar tucks it towards the leg side.
Short and outside off, Hafeez goes back and cuts it straight to the point fielder.
Full around middle, eased down to long on for one.

Good stop from Mohammed! Short and outside off, enough time for Azam to get back and force it through covers. Mohammed in the deep comes running to his left, dives full length to stop it from crossing the rope. Brilliant stop that, just a couple taken.
Loopy delivery around middle, Azam gets down and paddle sweeps it down to fine leg for a couple.
Loopy ball around off, turning away as the batsman pushes it away on the off side.
Flatter one around off, Azam defends it off the front foot.
Short delivery, angling in on the body, Azam hops and tickles it fine down the leg side for a single.
Short of a length delivery on off, tapped in front of point and this time they scamper through for a quick single.
Good length delivery on off, pushed firmly towards the cover region.
Gets behind the line and taps it towards point. Hafeez calls for a single but that was not on.

That missed the leg stump by a whisker! Fuller in length and angling in. Hafeez defends it with soft hands but gets an inside edge that rolls just past the leg pole. So close, Joseph has his hands on his head.
Short and angling in, Hafeez tucks it towards mid on.
Quicker through the air around off, Azam looks to cut but gets an inside edge on the pads as the ball rolls towards the off side. Good tight over from the leggie.
Drifting in from around middle, Azam presses forward in defense.
Stays back, allows the ball to turn and then dabs it towards the point fielder.
Hafeez lunges forward to this, takes it on the full and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman comes down the track to hit but mistimes it towards mid on.
Loopy delivery outside off, turning away sharply, Hafeez looks to push it away but gets beaten on the outside edge. Bishoo has got a few to spin here from that area.
Drinks!
FOUR! What a shot that is! Back of a length delivery on middle, Azam stands tall and pulls it through the gap between mid on and mid-wicket for a boundary. Pierced the gap to perfection there!

What happened there? Fuller and angling in, Hafeez works it towards mid on and sets off for a single. Meanwhile, Walton comes from covers to the stumps to collect a throw and Hafeez is running in the same direction. Walton doesn't collide but Hafeez seems to be annoyed as the fielder came in his way when he crossed.
Short outside off, cut through backward point for a single.
Short and outside off, a little bit of bounce off the deck, Hafeez hops and plays a ramp shot down to third man for a single.
Pitches it up again, around off, Hafeez drives it towards mid off.
Fuller in length and outside off, defended off the front foot towards covers.
Touch short and outside off, Hafeez camps back and punches it down to long off to keep strike.
Floated delivery around off, Azam milks it down to long off to get to the other end.
Flatter and quicker one around middle, Azam lunges forward and keeps it out with his bat and pad together.
Skidding through the surface as MH goes back and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Googly around off, dabbed towards short third man for one.
Quicker and a little too full outside off, Babar looks to cut it away but gets beaten as the ball goes under the bat to the keeper.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot.
Angles in a length ball outside off, gets some extra bounce off the deck as Hafeez slashes at it but gets beaten.

FOUR! Edged but safe! Joseph goes wide of the crease and hurls it on a length just outside off, Hafeez comes down a step to have a tame push at it. Gets an outside edge that flies past the right of the keeper and races down to the fence for a boundary.
In the channel outside off, easy leave for Mohammad.
Wide! Sprays it wide outside off, Hafeez doesn't look at it.
Fuller in length outside off, blocked off the front foot gently.
Fuller and angling in, Hafeez comes on the front foot and taps it towards the off side. Wanted a single but won't get it.
Floats it up outside off, bunted back to the bowler who dives to his left to stop it.
Full on off, eased down to long off for a single.
Skidding through the surface, Hafeez is beaten on his front foot push. Smiles at Bishoo after it.
Floats it outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Tossed up around off, driven hard but finds the cover fielder.
Quicker through the air around off, turning away, Azam comes forward to push it but fails to do so.
Devendra Bishoo called on for a bowl.
Fuller and in the channel outside off, Hafeez lifts his bat and allows it to go through to the keeper.
Fuller and angling on the pads, Babar shuffles a touch and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Short and outside off, Hafeez slashes it behind point for a single.
On a length and gets it to curl back in from outside off, Hafeez comes forward and then shoulders his arms to that one.
Fuller in length and outside off, driven straight back to the bowler who gets a hand to it but fails to stop. The ball goes towards mid off and they take a single.
Angles in a length delivery on middle, Hafeez tucks it towards the leg side for a single to get off the mark.
The umpire signals the start of the second Powerplay. Four fielders are now allowed outside the 30-yard circle for the next 30 overs.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
Fuller outside off, Azam comes forward and defends it.
Angles it on the stumps, Azam clips it through square leg for a single.
Fuller in length around off, played back down the wicket.
Shorter outside off, punched towards covers.
Angles it on the stumps, defended towards the leg side.
Mohammad Hafeez walks in next!

OUT! Another one is caught down the leg side! Joseph slants it on the leg stump, Kamran Akmal looks to clip it through but is caught behind by Hope. The keeper dives to his left to grab it. Two similar dismissals for Pakistan and they seem to be in some sort of trouble now. Replays show the players did not even have to appeal much. Pakistan really need to get grip on the game.
Good length outside off, another tap and run towards gully.
This time Kamran taps one towards the off side and scampers through for a quick run.
Good length outside off, Babar taps it towards point for a quick single.
FOUR! No need to run for that! Shorter outside off, Babar Azam gets on top of it and pummels it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Bowls it outside off, defended by the batsman watchfully.
Alzarri Joseph comes on for a bowl.
Shorter outside off, tapped towards point by the batsman.
Fuller outside off, Kamran looks to drive but gets an inside edge through square leg for a couple of runs.
Fuller outside off, Kamran looks to flay it through but fails to put bat to ball.
Angles it on a good length just around off, Azam fails to clip it and a huge appeal ensues. The batsmen cross for a run. There is a shy at the striker's end but the batsman had got in.
Beaten! Fuller outside off, Azam goes for the booming drive but is beaten by the outward movement.
Fuller in length on the stumps, Azam looks to clip it through the leg side but gets a leading edge back down the wicket. Had he missed that, would have been out.
FOUR! In the gap! The over ends how it started! Short and wide outside off, Kamran Akmal cuts it hard behind point for a boundary.
Good effort! Drives this one through covers. Powell gives it a chase from covers and dives at the fence to stop the ball. Three runs taken.
Drama! This one is bowled outside off on a length, Azam hits it straight to Powell at cover-point on the bounce. Oh dear, that was out for my teammate here but maybe he needs to get his eyes checked.
Free Hit time!
No ball! Shorter in length on middle and leg, Azam ducks under it. The umpire Ian Gould screams "no." Replays though show it wasn't a no ball.
Fuller in length on off, Kamran pushes it to covers for a quick single.
Outside off on a length, Kamran pushes it nicely into covers.
FOUR! Poor bowling! Short and wide outside off, Kamran does not miss out and flays it over backward point for a boundary. Can he make the Windies pay for the drop?
Outside off on a length, left alone.
FOUR! Top shot! Fuller but angling on the pads, Azam clips it through square leg for a majestic boundary. First one for the day and how good was it?
Kamran tucks this one towards mid-wicket and takes off. The fielder fails to collect the ball else there was a chance at the non-striker's end.

Dropped! Outside off on a length, Kamran throws his bat at it. The ball flies quickly to Walton at extra cover. Chadwick dives forward to catch it but spills the chance. That really should have been gobbled. Holder cannot believe his luck.
Guides this one towards point.
Beaten! Doles this outside off on a good length, Kamran feels for it from his crease and hangs his bat out for it. The ball goes away at the last moment and beats the batsman.
Good length outside off, Babar Azam gets in line and defends it.
Babar Azam is the new man in.

OUT! Shehzad has to walk back! The Windies were bowling that line to the Pakistan opener often and have been rewarded at last. Gabriel bowls it on a good length, just around middle and leg, Shehzad gets across to clip it but only manages to tickle it behind to the keeper who takes a good catch diving to his left. The umpire checks for the no ball but he was clean and that is the first breakthrough for the home side.
Good effort! Fuller outside off, Kamran drives it towards cover-point. Powell goes to his right and stops the ball from going through. A single results though.
Shorter in length outside off, Kamran gets under it and pulls it over mid-wicket for a couple of runs. Replays show it came off the splice of the bat.
Angles it around off on a good length, Akmal shapes to defend but gets an inside edge towards the on side.
Good length outside off, Kamran pulls it hard towards mid on. The frustration is building on the Pakistan openers.
Bowls it wide outside off on a length, left alone by Shehzad. The batsman is expecting the umpire to signal a wide but it was clean.
Full outside off, Shehzad comes forward and drives it towards covers.
A slip comes out and is at short mid-wicket now. Holder is reacting to the quick singles here.
Fuller in length around middle, worked to the right of mid on for a single.

Confusion but no harm done! Angles it around off, Akmal works it through backward square leg. There is slight hesitation between the two but they complete the second easily as the throw at the non-striker's end is not a good one.
Shorter outside off, Kamran stands tall and crunches it towards Walton at extra cover.
Akmal drives this one towards mid off but not in the gap.
Shorter outside off, Shehzad gets across and defends it with a hop towards the leg side.
Good length outside off, guided towards short third man by Shehzad.
Length ball outside off, Shehzad drives it on the up wide of the point fielder. The third man fielder gets across and stops the ball. Two runs taken.
WIDE! Slants it down the leg side on a length, Shehzad cannot clip it. The umpire signals it as a wide. Gabriel seems to be struggling with his footing here.
On a length outside off, pushed towards covers from the crease.
Fuller and angling on the stumps, Kamran fails to clip it again. The ball goes off the pads towards fine leg and the batsmen cross for a run. Leg bye signaled.
Fuller in length at 146 kph, but on the pads, Kamran looks to clip it but fails to put it away.

Almost chopped on! Holder goes wide of the crease and bowls it on good length, cramping Shehzad for room. The batsman looks to cut it but the ball is too close to him. The ball takes the bottom edge and falls wide of the stumps.
Fuller outside off, left alone outside off.
Doles it outside off on a good length, Shehzad lets it go through.
Too full angling on the stumps, clipped toward wide mid on for a single.
Nice shape! Angles this around off, the ball pitches and moves away, Akmal defends it watchfully.
A tad short outside off, Kamran dabs it towards gully from his crease.
WIDE! Starts off with a length ball outside off. The batsman lets it go. Wide signaled.
Jason Holder to bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
Fuller outside off, Kamran drives it down to third man for a single with an open face of the bat.
Shorter outside off, Shehzad slashes it down to third man for a single.
Shehzad defends this one towards square leg. The fielder gets across to stop the ball but fumbles and allows the ball to go in the deep. A couple taken.
Shorter in length outside off, at 144 kph, Shehzad gets behind it and defends it.
Angles it on a good length, Shehzad looks to work it through but gets hit high on the bat.
Nice start! Outside off on a length, Shehzad is opened up a touch but does well to defend it watchfully.

The players are out in the middle for the game. The two Pakistan openers are Ahmed Shehzad and Kamran Akmal. The home side begin the proceedings with Shannon Gabriel. He has a couple of slips in place for him. Here we go....
Pitch report - The deck looks a good one with a few rough areas. Expect it to be a good batting wicket with some help for the spinners. The seamers will get slight assistance too.

Pakistan skipper, Sarfraz Ahmed says it looks a good batting wicket with a bit of moisture on it. Further says 300-320 would be a good score and they are targeting once again to get that much. Hopes for a much better performance from his side today.

West Indies skipper, Jason Holder says that the wicket still looks the same. There is moisture on the wicket and they will want to make use of it. Calls it a fresh game and they want to repeat their good work from the last game. Adds that they are looking to be consistent.

TOSS - West Indies win the toss and elect to field! Sensible decision? They are backing themselves to chase down a total once again. They are unchanged from the previous game. Pakistan have made one change - Junaid Khan comes in for Wahab Riaz.

Hello everyone and a very warm welcome to the coverage of the second ODI between West Indies and Pakistan at the Providence Stadium, Guyana. The hosts made history in the opening encounter chasing down a score of over 300 for the very first time. Jason Holder and company will be hopeful of another good show to seal the series today itself. The pressure will be firmly on the tourists. Their bowlers wilted under pressure and Sarfraz Ahmed will want them to get their mojo back. West Indies have not won an ODI series against Pakistan since 1991 and that in itself should be enough motivation for the hosts. Should be a cracking contest. Stay tuned for the details from the toss.
